sentence: This project builds a system that uses oscillation of a thin injection cannula to place viral vectors accurately in deep brain locations.
This project tests whether a treatment aimed at parvalbumin inhibitory interneurons in the hippocampus can ease cognitive decline in aging.
This project tests a treatment for diabetic foot ulcers that combines electric field stimulation with nitric oxide therapy.
This project tests a molecular model of how mutations in virus receptor-binding proteins let viruses shift hosts.
This project works toward a gene editing cure for Duchenne muscular dystrophy and studies what limits gene editing therapies in skeletal muscle.
This project builds on a technology that maps antibody sequence to antigen specificity so it works for many kinds of antigen targets.
This project tests an immune activating agent to see whether it prevents cancer, including lung cancer caused by cigarette smoke, in animal models.
This project tries to find out at which step a membrane protease acts on a membrane protein that helps block virus host-cell fusion.
This project tests a genetic tool that helps clear protein aggregates from neurons, using mouse models of Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease.
This project offers protein, peptide and mass spectrometry services that help researchers analyze proteins and small molecules in cells, tissues and organisms.
This project studies how Notch signaling in the fetal liver controls genes that make fetal hematopoietic stem cells expand.
This project holds a meeting where researchers exchange information about computer algorithms for studying human DNA and proteins.
This project enrolls patients with hepatotoxicity caused by drugs to run genetic and biomarker studies and a clinical trial of budesonide.
This project creates methods, devices, algorithms and systems that help with surgery and intervention.
This project builds microscopic imaging tools for biological and clinical research.
This project supports research on HIV treatment and prevention, including long-acting treatment, hepatitis B and vaccines.
This project studies how a molecular cluster controls corneal sensory nerve function and immune interaction in Pseudomonas aeruginosa keratitis in mouse and human.
This project develops an immunochemotherapy for colorectal cancer that uses nanoparticles to deliver two treatments together.
This project tries to find out which heart cells exercise affects, how those cells interact, and what mechanisms lie behind these effects.
This project supports research on how behavioral and biomedical strategies for HIV testing, prevention and treatment can be adopted and used in real world practice.
